say:6:1421129001:1.text: Now I understand why Indris was the only one who passed the trial...
say:6:1421129001:1.source_cn: 我现在已经明白，为什么通过的人只有因度厄了……

say:7:1421129002:1.text: In fact, I think the trial was more of a joke directed at Imperator Ravion than a compromise from the other nobles.
say:7:1421129002:1.source_cn: 是的，你总算明白了，这两项测试与其说是对沙利叶大人的妥...

say:8:1421129003:1.source_cn: 而沙利叶大人却依旧坚持自己的主张。

say:9:1421129004:1.text: I'm not sure if he truly cared about the commoners who perished during the trial.
say:9:1421129004:1.source_cn: 我不知道在他的考量里面，有多少“先牺牲部分倒霉蛋，缓解...

say:10:1421129005:1.text: But he undoubtedly achieved his goal, largely thanks to Captain Indris...
say:10:1421129005:1.source_cn: 但不得不说，因度厄大人的成功，某种程度上也确实实现了沙...

say:11:1421129006:1.text: His reforms succeeded at the cost of numerous commoners' lives...
say:11:1421129006:1.source_cn: 这种争斗，却需要平民的血肉乃至生命去拼抢……

narration:13:1421129007:0.text: The mood turns somber, the silence stretching until Xera finally speaks, her voice cutting through the quiet like a blade.
narration:13:1421129007:0.source_cn: 短暂地沉默了一会儿，还是席蕾率先打破了有些凝重的气氛。

say:15:1421129008:1.text: You know what? Captain Indris almost punched the Imperator in the face when he first joined the guards.
say:15:1421129008:1.source_cn: 说起来，刚进队伍的时候，沙利叶大人还差点被因度厄大人揍了呢？

say:16:1421129009:1.text: What? How did that happen? Tell us!
say:16:1421129009:1.source_cn: 啊？什么情况！快快快，快说来听听！

say:17:1421129010:1.text: Wow, gossip really is magic, huh? Your eyes lit up the moment I mentioned it!
say:17:1421129010:1.source_cn: ……你！刚刚还一脸悲伤的，怎么一听这种消息就两眼放光！

choice_prompt:18:1421129010.text: Wow, gossip really is magic, huh? Your eyes lit up the moment I mentioned it!
choice_prompt:18:1421129010.source_cn: ……你！刚刚还一脸悲伤的，怎么一听这种消息就两眼放光！

say:19:1421129011:1.text: You too? Fine, it's not a big deal. Long story short, Imperator Ravion has a bad habit, and he was at it one day.
say:19:1421129011:1.source_cn: 连您都……好吧好吧，说出来也没什么，就是沙利叶大人那时...
say:19:1421129011:1.male: You too? Fine, it's not a big deal. Long story short, Imperator Ravion has a bad habit, and he was at it one day.
say:19:1421129011:1.female: You too? Fine, it's not a big deal. Long story short, Imperator Ravion has a bad habit, and he was at it one day.

say:20:1421129012:1.text: He just can't resist making suggestive remarks when he runs into someone good-looking.
say:20:1421129012:1.source_cn: 看到长得还行的人，就忍不住口头占点便宜。

say:21:1421129013:1.text: Back then, most of the guards were nobles, and they all knew the Imperator personally.
say:21:1421129013:1.source_cn: 以前卫队中的人都是贵族出身，大家彼此之间或多或少知根知底。

say:22:1421129014:1.text: Whenever he said something inappropriate, they just let it slide even if they were upset.
say:22:1421129014:1.source_cn: 所以都是一笑而过，就算生气也得给沙利叶大人点面子。

say:23:1421129015:1.text: Meanwhile, Indris, as the only commoner among the guards, was a complete outsider. He didn't know he had to show respect to Imperator Ravion.
say:23:1421129015:1.source_cn: 但因度厄是通过测试的独苗，本来就孤家寡人，又没人带他，...

say:24:1421129016:1.text: So, one thing led to another, and a fight broke out...
say:24:1421129016:1.source_cn: 这样那样，那样这样，总之就打起来了……

say:25:1421129017:1.text: Feels like you left out quite a lot of details... Anyway, what happened next? Who won?
say:25:1421129017:1.source_cn: 总觉得你略过了很多内容……不管了，后面呢？谁赢了？

choice_prompt:26:1421129017.text: Feels like you left out quite a lot of details... Anyway, what happened next? Who won?
choice_prompt:26:1421129017.source_cn: 总觉得你略过了很多内容……不管了，后面呢？谁赢了？

say:27:1421129018:1.text: Hmm, if we go by the book, I'd say Indris was the winner. After all, he nearly smashed the Imperator's mask to pieces.
say:27:1421129018:1.source_cn: 唔，你要按格斗的规则来说，那确实是因度厄赢了，当时沙利...
say:27:1421129018:1.male: Hmm, if we go by the book, I'd say Indris was the winner. After all, he nearly smashed the Imperator's mask to pieces.
say:27:1421129018:1.female: Hmm, if we go by the book, I'd say Indris was the winner. After all, he nearly smashed the Imperator's mask to pieces.

say:28:1421129021:1.text: It caused quite a stir at the time, but Imperator Ravion spoke up for Indris, so he was spared from punishment.
say:28:1421129021:1.source_cn: 当时闹得挺大的，不过沙利叶大人替因度厄求情，就免于处罚了。

say:29:1421129022:1.text: Ah, I remember Indris went on his first mission shortly after that brawl.
say:29:1421129022:1.source_cn: 啊，对了，我想起来了，在这场私斗后不久，因度厄就去第一...

say:30:1421129023:0.text: Anyway, let me take you to the mission site... that place had a huge impact on him...
say:30:1421129023:0.source_cn: 我带你们去那个地方看看吧，那里对他的影响很大……

narration:34:14021135:0.text: You all stretch out on the grass, take a breather, and discuss Indris' past.
narration:34:14021135:0.source_cn: 你们躺在草坪上休息了一会，又聊了更多关于因度厄的过去。
narration:34:14021135:0.male: You all stretch out on the grass, take a breather, and discuss Indris' past.
narration:34:14021135:0.female: You all stretch out on the grass, take a breather, and discuss Indris' past.

say:35:1421129019:1.text: Hmm... Judging by the outcome, I'd say Lord Ravion prevailed in the end. At least five guards had Indris pinned to the ground, making sure he couldn't move.
say:35:1421129019:1.source_cn: 唔，你要按结果来说，那是沙利叶大人赢了，至少五个人把因...
say:35:1421129019:1.male: Hmm... Judging by the outcome, I'd say Lord Ravion prevailed in the end. At least five guards had Indris pinned to the ground, making sure he couldn't move.
say:35:1421129019:1.female: Hmm... Judging by the outcome, I'd say Lord Ravion prevailed in the end. At least five guards had Indris pinned to the ground, making sure he couldn't move.

choice:26:1:2.text: I put my money on Ravion!
choice:26:1:2.male: I put my money on Ravion!
choice:26:1:2.female: I put my money on Ravion!

say:36:1421129020:1.text: Yeah, it was. It took a bunch of people to finally break them apart...
say:36:1421129020:1.source_cn: 这确实，两个人打成一团，最后来了好些人才把他们分开……
say:36:1421129020:1.male: Yeah, it was. It took a bunch of people to finally break them apart...
say:36:1421129020:1.female: Yeah, it was. It took a bunch of people to finally break them apart...
